description: A four-stage envelope generator with a button for firing it by hand

params.text: Sets how long the envelope takes to rise to full
Sets how long it takes to fall from full to the sustain level
Sets the level the envelope holds at while the gate stays up
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall away once the gate drops
Opens the envelope for as long as it is held down

inputs.text: A gate above 1.2V starts the envelope and holds it at the sustain level until it falls again
